title: eDNA Extraction Using Phenol-Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol from Filters in Longmire Buffer
author: Ana Ramón-Laca
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bx4apqse

steps.title: Heat shock filters
steps.instruction: Place each filter in 2 ml Longmire buffer, heat at 95 °C for 5 minutes, then allow the tubes to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl proteinase K to each tube to obtain a final concentration of 1 mg ml⁻¹ and mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare phase‑lock tubes
steps.instruction: Using a syringe, add approximately 800 µl vacuum grease to the wall of each 5 ml tube; prepare one set for the phenol‑chloroform step and a second set (two tubes) for the subsequent chloroform‑isoamyl (CI) extraction.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl (25:24:1), pH 8, to each sample, shake well, then centrifuge at 13 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous layer to a fresh phase‑lock tube that already contains ~800 µl vacuum grease (the CI tube).

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 2.2 ml chloroform:isoamyl (24:1) to the transferred aqueous phase, mix briefly, then centrifuge at 13 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4 °C; decant the upper aqueous layer into a new tube. (Add the chloroform just before use while the PCI tubes are in the centrifuge so the grease remains at the bottom.)

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: To the aqueous phase, add 2 ml isopropanol and 80 µl of 5 M NaCl, then invert the tube several times to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 800 µl ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 13 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and repeat the ethanol wash once more.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Pour off any remaining liquid slowly and allow the tube to air‑dry for 1 hour or until the pellet is completely dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 100 µl TE buffer pre‑warmed to 37 °C.
